mapper.select: SELECT u.* FROM user u LEFT JOIN doctor_profile d ON u.id = d.doctor_id WHERE u.role_type = 'doctor' AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND d.doctor_id IS NULL

SELECT dp.*, u.username AS doctorName FROM doctor_profile dp LEFT JOIN user u ON dp.doctor_id = u.id WHERE 1 = 1
AND dp.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{doctorName}, '%')
AND dp.hospital LIKE CONCAT('%', #{hospital}, '%')
AND dp.department LIKE CONCAT('%', #{department}, '%')
ORDER BY dp.create_time DESC
